nl_request: Find the procurement requests with a request date on or after 2024-03-25 and before 2025-03-04, for an amount of at least 5000, from vendors with a risk rating of at least 2, requested by an employee in the Customer Support or Operations department, with no need-by date recorded. Return the IDs of the matching procurement requests.
reference_sql:
SELECT pr.id
FROM procurement_requests AS pr
JOIN vendors AS v ON v.id = pr.vendor_id
JOIN employees AS e ON e.id = pr.requested_by_employee_id
JOIN departments AS d ON d.id = e.department_id
WHERE pr.requested_at >= '2024-03-25'
  AND pr.requested_at < '2025-03-04'
  AND pr.amount >= 5000
  AND v.risk_rating >= 2
  AND d.name IN ('Customer Support', 'Operations')
  AND pr.needed_by IS NULL
ORDER BY pr.id
